verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Floot serves an llms.txt at https://floot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, and the docs also include an llms-full.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Agent-facing docs like "What your AI can do" add to this. missing for 10: markdown doc variants (docs.md returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
